entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...I'm home.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Hi, Sis.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You look tired... Is everything okay?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Don't worry about me. How about you,[n]Makoto? Have you been keeping up[n]with your studies?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes, of course.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Though... what is the point of studying?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...What do you mean?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I was just wondering what will be[n]waiting for me at the end...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Even if I manage to push through tough[n]entrance exams, I'm still thrust into[n]a competitive society.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: What else is there besides success?[n]Don't ask me such childish questions.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Isn't this the man the Phantom Thieves[n]sent a calling card for? I heard he[n]confessed all his crimes.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: Even the police couldn't figure out why.[n]It really... was out of nowhere.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: This would only make sense if his[n]personality changed... but that would be[n]impossible.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Why does it matter? The police still[n]caught him in the end, right?

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: I had plans set for a promotion, but[n]no one can take credit for his arrest[n]now with that confession.

entries.speaker: Sae
entries.en: ...Not that a child would understand.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So she was pursuing the case after all.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Promotion...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You've changed, Sis.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But... I'll be okay.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...I finally found a place where I belong.
entries.uk: ...Я нарешті знайшла місце, де[n]мені належить бути.
